summary: List the CAA results of certificates

200.description: One entry per Let's Encrypt (ACME) certificate the user can view; custom and mTLS certificates have none

description:
The cached CAA result of each certificate, by id. A result older than 6 hours or missing is checked again before the answer, for at most 25 certificates per call (4 lookups at once); the others answer `not-checked` until a later call. A save, re-issue, renewal or delete of a certificate clears its result.
